scope: synthetic calibrated profile segmentation; retrospective real observations; no economic ground truth
penalty: max(1e-12,c*d*pooled_train_residual_variance*log(24)); variance after frozen calendar correction and entity mean, df=11; only first12 months
calibration: Smallest c with mean false persistent object fraction <=.05 in EACH applicable null cell over16 tune seeds; positive cells not used. None passing=>NO_CALIBRATED_CANDIDATE, no extended grid.
signal: 8/32 affected objects, direction e1, change at t=12 zero-based; P6 returns t=18; C3 onset t=21; AR innovations sqrt(1-rho^2); stationary first noise. Same initial12 data across cells of a seed except explicitly distinct null generator.
calendar: Known common annual sinusoidal template in first two coordinates; estimator frozen from first12 means after entity centering; repeated12 offsets. Relative channel subtracts cohort median with common drift preserved.
null_semantics: N3 absolute is positive/common, relative null; spike is null for persistent events; q-boundary changes are not mean-shift truth
scoring: one-to-one boundary matching +-1month; persistent event eligible when following segment>=6; truth zero recall=null; return event separately; C3 censored not recall denominator
uncertainty: 10000 percentile bootstrap over64 root seeds; additionally one randomly selected representative object per seed/cell and one-sided95% Clopper-Pearson FPR upper bound; per-cell not simultaneous and not real-world FWER
promotion: Deterministic invariants PASS; selected c exists; each applicable null full FPR<=.05 AND representative Clopper-Pearson upper<=.05. Full power curve published regardless. No universal minimum recall.
stop: One frozen primary min_size=3 run. No min_size grid, extra model, changed seeds or outcome-driven threshold. m6 sensitivity and broader stresses are deferred before any fit, not selectively omitted after outcomes.
resource_budget: Technical fixture pilot before tune; checkpoint by seed, initial60min compute budget. Timeout => INCOMPLETE, not subset pass.
reference_design: Temporal design memo 2026-10-09; only the above registered primary scope executes. Historical benchmarks remain separate.
